name: Planning-Only Verification Route
description: Run verify-plan against declared adapter manifests, policy and observations; it records planning decisions only, without spawning, dispatching or accepting an adapter.

harness_contract.intent: Plan adapter selection from host-declared documents only. No adapter is spawned, dispatched or accepted, and the selected adapter is not a verification result.
artifact_contracts: Read the request, policy, adapter manifests and host-declared observations under scenarios/verify_plan/src/.
The priority plan selects beta by declared priority; beta-unavailable fallback selects alpha and records beta as fallback_from.
A gamma adapter requiring network.connect is excluded by the policy that allows only process.spawn, with its tested exclusion reason.
A request with an unsupported profile emits a plan whose selected field is null; the planning command exits 0.
Input fixture hashes match before and after planning. Plans contain no injected environment sentinel or adapter execution, dispatch or acceptance record.
notes: PLANNING-ONLY: adapter selection is planning metadata, not a verification result.
Availability and tool versions are host-declared observations; this route does not probe or invoke adapters.
The permission-exclusion case uses network.connect against the declared process.spawn-only policy.
The unsupported-profile case has no compatible adapter and is reported with selected: null.

steps.name: Snapshot declared planner input bytes
steps.artifact_contract: Record SHA-256 hashes for every source fixture used by the four plans.
steps.verifier_gate: The final integrity step must reproduce this exact hash listing.

steps.name: Plan: select the highest-priority compatible adapter
steps.command: MUMEI_TEST_SECRET=FAKE_SECRET_SENTINEL_VALUE_9f2c1d {mumei_agent_python} -m agent verify-plan --request {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/request.json --adapters {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/adapters.json --policy {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/policy.json --observations {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/observations.json --output {output_dir}/plan_priority.json > {output_dir}/plan_priority.stdout 2> {output_dir}/plan_priority.stderr; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/plan_priority.json; cat {output_dir}/plan_priority.stdout; cat {output_dir}/plan_priority.stderr; test $rc -eq 0 && {mumei_agent_python} -c 'import json,sys; p=sys.argv[1]; d=json.load(open(p)); reasons=dict((x["adapter_id"],x["reasons"]) for x in d["decisions"]); assert d["schema_version"] == "mumei.verification-plan/v1"; assert d["selected"]["adapter_id"] == "beta" and d["fallback_from"] is None; assert reasons["beta"] == ["selected_priority"] and reasons["alpha"] == ["compatible_not_selected"]; assert not any(k in d for k in ("candidate","acceptance","dispatch","selected_result","accepted")); assert "FAKE_SECRET_SENTINEL_VALUE_9f2c1d" not in open(p).read(); print("priority selection only; injected environment sentinel absent")' {output_dir}/plan_priority.json
expected_patterns: priority selection only; injected environment sentinel absent
steps.artifact_contract: plan_priority.json uses mumei.verification-plan/v1, selects beta, records the exact tested decision reasons and has no fallback origin or execution record.
steps.verifier_gate: The route exits 0 and its output omits the injected environment sentinel.

steps.name: Plan: fall back when beta is unavailable
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent verify-plan --request {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/request.json --adapters {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/adapters.json --policy {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/policy_fallback.json --observations {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/observations_beta_missing.json --output {output_dir}/plan_unavailable_fallback.json > {output_dir}/plan_unavailable_fallback.stdout 2> {output_dir}/plan_unavailable_fallback.stderr; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/plan_unavailable_fallback.json; cat {output_dir}/plan_unavailable_fallback.stdout; cat {output_dir}/plan_unavailable_fallback.stderr; test $rc -eq 0 && {mumei_agent_python} -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); reasons=dict((x["adapter_id"],x["reasons"]) for x in d["decisions"]); assert d["schema_version"] == "mumei.verification-plan/v1"; assert d["selected"]["adapter_id"] == "alpha" and d["fallback_from"] == "beta"; assert reasons["alpha"] == ["selected_fallback"] and "tool_missing" in reasons["beta"]; print("beta unavailable; alpha selected with beta fallback origin")' {output_dir}/plan_unavailable_fallback.json
steps.artifact_contract: With beta's host-declared availability set to missing, the plan selects alpha and records fallback_from as beta.
steps.verifier_gate: The route exits 0 and the plan retains the unavailable requested adapter as fallback origin.

steps.name: Plan: exclude an adapter outside the permission policy
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent verify-plan --request {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/request.json --adapters {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/adapters_permissions.json --policy {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/policy.json --observations {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/observations_permissions.json --output {output_dir}/plan_permission_excluded.json > {output_dir}/plan_permission_excluded.stdout 2> {output_dir}/plan_permission_excluded.stderr; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/plan_permission_excluded.json; cat {output_dir}/plan_permission_excluded.stdout; cat {output_dir}/plan_permission_excluded.stderr; test $rc -eq 0 && {mumei_agent_python} -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); reasons=dict((x["adapter_id"],x["reasons"]) for x in d["decisions"]); assert d["schema_version"] == "mumei.verification-plan/v1"; assert d["selected"]["adapter_id"] == "beta"; assert reasons["gamma"] == ["permissions_not_allowed"]; print("gamma excluded: permissions_not_allowed")' {output_dir}/plan_permission_excluded.json
steps.artifact_contract: The permission-specific plan excludes gamma, whose declared network.connect requirement is outside policy.allowed_permissions.
steps.verifier_gate: The route exits 0 and reports the tested permissions_not_allowed decision reason.

steps.name: Plan: report no compatible adapter
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent verify-plan --request {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/request_no_compatible.json --adapters {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/adapters.json --policy {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/policy.json --observations {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/observations.json --output {output_dir}/plan_no_compatible.json > {output_dir}/plan_no_compatible.stdout 2> {output_dir}/plan_no_compatible.stderr; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/plan_no_compatible.json; cat {output_dir}/plan_no_compatible.stdout; cat {output_dir}/plan_no_compatible.stderr; test $rc -eq 0 && {mumei_agent_python} -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); assert d["schema_version"] == "mumei.verification-plan/v1"; assert d["selected"] is None and d["fallback_from"] is None; assert all("unsupported_semantic_profile" in x["reasons"] for x in d["decisions"]); print("no compatible adapter; selected is null")' {output_dir}/plan_no_compatible.json
expected_patterns: no compatible adapter; selected is null
steps.artifact_contract: An unsupported request profile returns an ordinary plan document with selected: null and exit status 0.
steps.verifier_gate: The scenario pins selected: null rather than inventing a nonzero-exit contract.

steps.name: Check input integrity and planning-only output
steps.command: before=$(cat {output_dir}/input_hashes.before); after=$(sha256sum {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/request.json {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/policy.json {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/adapters.json {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/observations.json {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/policy_fallback.json {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/observations_beta_missing.json {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/adapters_permissions.json {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/observations_permissions.json {root_dir}/scenarios/verify_plan/src/request_no_compatible.json); test "$before" = "$after" && {mumei_agent_python} -c 'import json,sys; sentinel="FAKE_SECRET_SENTINEL_VALUE_9f2c1d"; execution=set(("candidate","acceptance","dispatch","selected_result","accepted")); texts=[open(p).read() for p in sys.argv[1:]]; assert all(sentinel not in text for text in texts); assert all(not execution.intersection(json.loads(text).keys()) for p,text in zip(sys.argv[1:],texts) if p.endswith(".json")); print("input hashes unchanged; no secret/environment values or execution records")' {output_dir}/plan_priority.json {output_dir}/plan_priority.stdout {output_dir}/plan_priority.stderr {output_dir}/plan_unavailable_fallback.json {output_dir}/plan_unavailable_fallback.stdout {output_dir}/plan_unavailable_fallback.stderr {output_dir}/plan_permission_excluded.json {output_dir}/plan_permission_excluded.stdout {output_dir}/plan_permission_excluded.stderr {output_dir}/plan_no_compatible.json {output_dir}/plan_no_compatible.stdout {output_dir}/plan_no_compatible.stderr
expected_patterns: no secret/environment values or execution records
steps.artifact_contract: All declared input fixture hashes remain unchanged; plan documents omit the injected environment sentinel and any execution or acceptance record.
steps.verifier_gate: Only planning outputs are present: the route never spawns or dispatches an adapter, accepts anything, or returns a verifier result.

narrative.moment: Planning only: beta selected by priority; no verifier result is produced.
intro: Step 1: plan_priority selects beta by declared priority.
Step 2: missing beta falls back to alpha.
Step 3: gamma is excluded by policy permissions.
Step 4: no supported profile yields selected: null.
Step 5: inputs unchanged; no adapter is executed.
narrative.before: No local plan records the declared adapter choice or exclusion reasons.
narrative.after: Plans record selection, fallback and exclusion reasons without executing an adapter; selection is not a verification result.

pass.headline: verify-plan: beta selected by priority
follow_up: mumei.verification-plan/v1 records beta as the selected adapter.
Decision reasons match the route tests; fallback_from is null.
Planning only: no adapter is spawned, dispatched or accepted.

pass.headline: verify-plan: fallback_from beta
follow_up: Host-declared missing availability selects alpha as the fallback.
fallback_from names beta, the requested adapter.
Selection is not a verifier execution or result.

pass.headline: verify-plan: gamma excluded by policy
follow_up: gamma requires network.connect, outside the declared permission set.
The plan reports permissions_not_allowed for gamma.

pass.headline: verify-plan: no compatible adapter
follow_up: An unsupported profile leaves selected null with exit status 0.
The output is a planning document, not a verification result.

pass.headline: Inputs unchanged; planning-only boundary holds
follow_up: Every declared fixture hash matches its initial snapshot.
No fake environment value or execution record appears in any plan.
